output_basis: local completion_tokens used as a stand-in for the cloud output
pricing_model: cache on, cold per task: call 1 writes its prompt (5m write rate), call k reads call k-1's prompt (hit rate) and writes the rest; usd_all_uncached = every input token at input rate
token_basis: calls[].prompt_tokens_est (harness estimate of the prompt sent), not Anthropic's tokenizer
